titre: Paiements par carte dans la zone euro
sous_titre: Milliards de paiements par carte, par semestre, 2024 et 2025

series.nom: Paiements par carte dans la zone euro

S1 2024.texte: the number of card payments within the euro area increased by 10.3% to 40.1 billion compared with the first half of 2023

S2 2024.texte: In the second half of 2024 the number of card payments within the euro area increased by 11.3% to 44.3 billion

S1 2025.texte: In the first half of 2025 the number of card payments within the euro area was 44.0 billion, 9.6% higher

S2 2025.texte: In the second half of 2025 the number of card payments within the euro area was 47.8 billion, 7.9% higher
